newsitem.title: USA: DuPont Photomasks makes $18 mln investment.
newsitem.headline: DuPont Photomasks makes $18 mln investment.

text.p: DuPont Photomasks Inc said on Tuesday it had invested more than $18 million in equipment as part of an expansion program to meet international customer demand for photomasks.
Among the new equipment, DPI said it was installing a writing tool on a new production line at its Ichon, Korea, facility and an electron beam pattern generation system in the United States.

"Production capacity will also expand in Europe, where DPI's Hamburg, Germany, facility will receive a CORE 2500 writing tool that was formerly intalled in the Ichon plant," the company said in a statement.
Photomasks, used in semiconductor manufacturing, pattern precision microscopic images of integrated circuits onto silicon wafers.
